description_en: Enables Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) for an instance
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx update-db-instance-tde --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-hzjasd0000 --tde-status 1 --encryption-key RkVBNURDMjAtNkQ4QS01OTc5LTk3QUEtRkM1NzU0Nk000000 --role-arn acs:ram::14069260000:role/aliyunrdsinstanceencryptiondefaultrole --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDBInstanceTDE

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Enables TDE. Set this parameter to 1
parameters.name: tde_status

parameters.help_en: The custom key ID. If you do not specify this parameter, a key is automatically generated by the backend
parameters.help_zh: 自定义密钥ID时传入。也可以不传入使用后端自动生成
parameters.name: encryption_key

parameters.help_en: The global resource descriptor of the role. This parameter specifies the role to assume. For details, see RAM role overview
parameters.help_zh: 角色的全局资源描述符，用来指定具体角色。详情请参见RAM角色概览
parameters.name: role_arn
